title: geraniospermum athamanthoides
intro: Geraniospermum athamanthoides, commonly known as Geranium, is a plant species in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to reduce pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Geraniospermum athamanthoides include analgesic, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it a useful remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniol, linalool, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
